headline: Finolex Industries Q2 revenue jumps 27% as EBITDA falls
hook: Volume growth fails to boost operating margins
summary: Finolex Industries reported a 27% increase in revenue for the second quarter, driven by a 28% rise in sales volumes. Despite the strong top-line performance, the company's EBITDA declined during the period. The results highlight a divergence between sales growth and operational profitability for the pipe manufacturer. Retail investors should note the margin pressure despite robust demand.
why_it_matters: Margin compression may weigh on stock price despite volume growth.

headline: Finolex Industries reports financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
summary: Finolex Industries has officially submitted its financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange.
